UNIT 1: HOBBIES – LOOKING BACK & PROJECT

Thời gian làm bài: 60 phút • Tổng điểm tối đa: 10.0

Chế độ: Tự học & Chấm điểm tự động
🎧 Listening Audio Engine

Băng Nghe Bản Gốc (Giọng Nữ Anh-Mỹ chuẩn)

Ấn nút Play dưới đây để nghe cuộc trò chuyện giữa các bạn Tom, Mai và John.

Sẵn sàng phát âm thanh... 00:00 / 00:00
[ Nhấn nút Play để bắt đầu luyện nghe ]

A. LISTENING (2.0 POINTS)

10 câu hỏi
I

Listen and choose A, B or C. (Nghe và chọn đáp án đúng nhất)

1. What is the conversation about?

2. What does Tom like doing?

3. What does Mai collect?

4. What does John do every Tuesday?

5. Why do they like hobbies?

II

Listen and select True (T) or False (F). (Nghe và chọn Đúng hoặc Sai)

6. Tom likes building models.
7. Mai hates collecting coins.
8. John does judo every Tuesday.
9. Hobbies help people spend time together.
10. They never share hobbies with friends.

B. VOCABULARY AND GRAMMAR (3.0 POINTS)

15 câu hỏi
I

Multiple choice. (Chọn đáp án chính xác nhất)

11. Choose the word with a different pronunciation in the underlined part:

12. Choose the word with a different stress pattern:

13. I like ______ models in my free time.

14. She enjoys ______ coins.

15. He hates ______ football alone.

16. My brother ______ judo every Tuesday.

17. They ______ football at the weekend.

18. I don’t like ______ homework.

19. We usually spend time ______ together.

20. My hobby is ______.

II

Find the Error. (Bấm chọn 1 phần gạch chân chứa lỗi ngữ pháp)

Câu hỏi 21:

She enjoyA playingB footballC every dayD.
Bấm chọn trực tiếp vào từ viết sai ở trên để đổi đáp án.

Câu hỏi 22:

He isA interestedB onC gardeningD.
Bấm chọn trực tiếp vào từ viết sai ở trên để đổi đáp án.
III

Verb forms. (Chia động từ trong ngoặc)

23. My father (like) ______ gardening very much.
24. They (not/play) ______ football every day.
25. I (enjoy) ______ drawing pictures.

C. READING COMPREHENSION (2.4 POINTS)

12 câu hỏi
I

Picture description. (Xem hình vẽ và chọn đáp án chính xác)

Hình minh họa Q26

26. A picture shows children playing football in a park. What is the best description?

II

Cloze passage. (Điền từ thích hợp nhất vào ô trống trong đoạn văn)

My name is Lan. I have many hobbies such as drawing, playing sports, and collecting coins. I enjoy pictures in my free time. I also like football with my friends at the weekend. My brother does judo every Tuesday. We usually spend time together after school. Hobbies help us feel happy and stress. Each of my friends has his or her own .
III

Reading passage. (Đọc văn bản và trả lời câu hỏi trắc nghiệm bên dưới)

Hobbies are very important in our life. Each person has his or her own hobby. Some people like collecting coins or dolls, while others enjoy playing sports like football or doing judo. My brother likes making models of cars and planes. My sister loves drawing pictures every day. I enjoy gardening with my parents at the weekend. We often spend time together and share our hobbies. Hobbies help us relax, reduce stress, and make new friends. They also help us become more creative and responsible.

32. What is the best title?

33. What does the brother like doing?

34. What does the sister love?

35. What does “they” refer to? (They help us relax)

36. What is NOT mentioned?

37. Why are hobbies important?

D. INTERACTIVE WRITING & MINI-REVIEW (2.6 POINTS)

12 câu hỏi
I

Arrange words. (Bấm chọn các từ để tạo thành câu hoàn chỉnh)

38. / like / I / drawing / pictures /

39. / enjoys / she / collecting / coins /

40. / do / you / like / football / ? /

II

Rewrite sentences. (Điền từ/cụm từ ngắn thích hợp để hoàn thành câu viết lại)

41. I like drawing.

➔ My hobby is .

42. She enjoys collecting coins.

➔ She is interested coins.

43. Do you like football?

➔ Are you interested football?

44. He doesn’t like homework.

➔ He hates homework.

45. I like spending time with friends.

➔ I enjoy time with friends.
III

Conversational Quick Match. (Nối câu hỏi với câu trả lời phù hợp nhất)

1 What is your hobby?
2 When do you do it?
3 Who do you share it with?
4 Why do you like it?
A. I share it with my elder brother.
B. Because it keeps me creative.
C. I like making paper models.
D. Usually on Sunday mornings.
